comments.body:
A bit annoying. IBMZ cannot legally pay students as it has an agreement with both ETH and EPFL to not pay interns. Both sides benefit from it, except for the student of course.

My honest suggestion would be to not work with them unless you are really enthusiastic about the project you would carry out. I turned them down for this reason 6 years ago, and do not regret that one bit.
comments.author: Fndundai
